note: The pinned fork bundles two MAT files used by its tutorial notebooks together with PINN and DeepONet examples. The MAT contents were not opened or normalized in Stage 2.
README identifies external Google Drive data. The pinned repository bundles problem notebooks and Posting.zip; the archive was not unpacked and external data were not downloaded.

The FEniCS Project website and documentation describe a finite-element software platform and tutorials rather than a standalone research dataset. No dataset is inferred from papers or downstream projects that use FEniCS.

PhiFlow bundles simulation examples and documentation. README notes the framework has been used to create external public datasets including PDEBench and PDEarena; those datasets are not bundled repository data for this resource.
DiffTaichi bundles simulator scripts and small demonstration/configuration/image assets, not a standalone research dataset. No external media linked from README are treated as bundled data.
